signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: Today, Apple is pleased to report $109.4 billion in revenue, up 16% from a year ago and a June quarter record.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: We continue to see enormous customer enthusiasm for our most popular lineup ever, with iPhone revenue growing 22% from a year ago to reach a June quarter record.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: We saw so much excitement around the best Mac lineup we've ever had, growing a strong 29% to achieve a June quarter revenue record.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: Services also set a June quarter record with $30.7 billion in revenue.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: We achieved June quarter revenue records in every geographic segment.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: We were pleased to see strength across the board with June quarter records in the U.S., Latin America, Western Europe, India, China Mainland, Japan, and Southeast Asia.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: We also achieved June quarter revenue records in both developed and emerging markets and saw double-digit growth in most emerging markets.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: This year's WWDC was a wonderful showcase of our latest innovations.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: We were tremendously excited to unveil the all-new Siri AI, a completely reimagined version of Siri that is profoundly capable, deeply personal, and integrated seamlessly across our platforms.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: We've been absolutely thrilled by the response from people who've been using Siri AI in the developer and public betas.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: The reviews from early users have been phenomenal, it's been so wonderful to hear from people who are excited about the capabilities we've built.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: It underscores our philosophy that building AI that is private and based on personal context can change how users find information and get things done with our products in a way that truly enriches their lives.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: We really couldn't be more excited about it, we are feeling incredibly enthusiastic about the impact it's going to have.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: At WWDC, we also announced new tools to help parents keep kids safe online, we were pleased by the overwhelmingly positive reaction.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: These new tools integrate guidance from leading clinical and child development research, including the American Academy of Pediatrics.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: We're looking forward to bringing these new capabilities to users this fall, in addition to amazing new updates across our operating systems.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: iPhone revenue for the June quarter was $54.3 billion, up 22% from a year ago.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: We achieved June quarter records in every geographic segment and set a June quarter record for upgraders.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: According to IDC, we gained share globally during the quarter.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: As I've said before, this is the most powerful and most popular iPhone lineup we've ever had.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: More people are relying on iPhone every day for AI, powered by the outstanding performance of A19 and A19 Pro.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: Across the lineup, iPhone continues to deliver the performance, battery life, durability, and camera capabilities that people count on every day.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: Whether it's the extraordinary camera system of iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max, the remarkably thin design of iPhone Air, the balanced performance and durability of iPhone 17, or the exceptional value of iPhone 17e, there's an iPhone for every customer.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: Mac delivered its best June quarter yet with $10.4 billion in revenue, growing an impressive 29% from a year ago despite significant supply constraints.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: This revenue growth was driven by the incredible strength of our latest lineup with MacBook Pro and the all-new MacBook Neo.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: According to IDC, we gained share globally.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: We also set a June quarter revenue record in developed markets and an all-time record in emerging markets with particular strength in Greater China, where we had an all-time revenue record.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: In addition, we achieved all-time records for upgraders and customers new to Mac.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: With the power of Apple silicon, the Mac lineup delivers outstanding power-efficient performance, massive memory bandwidth, and next-level AI capabilities.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: Mac continues to be the ultimate AI powerhouse, excelling at high throughput, on-device inference, and creation across a broad range of AI workloads.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: We're seeing customers increasingly put those capabilities to work, from using Mac mini as a powerful platform for agentic AI to deploying clusters of Mac Studio systems to run frontier class models locally.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: Across the lineup, customers continue to embrace the Mac family.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: MacBook Neo has been especially popular with its distinctive design and excellent value resonating with customers around the world, we're continuing to work hard to meet demand.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: MacBook Air, the world's most popular laptop, continues to deliver the portability and performance customers love with M5.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: MacBook Pro, powered by M5 Pro and M5 Max, remains a go-to choice for professionals tackling the most demanding AI development and creative workflows.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: iPad continues to be the ultimate go-anywhere, do anything device for students, entrepreneurs, and creators of all kinds, thanks to its incredible power, portability, and versatility.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: Together with the remarkable performance of iPad Pro, the amazing value and versatility of iPad, and the ultra-portable iPad mini, we're offering customers our strongest iPad lineup ever.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: Revenue for wearables, home, and accessories was $7.9 billion, up 6% from a year ago.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: We grew in every geographic segment and achieved a June quarter record for upgraders for Apple Watch.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: Our Apple Watch lineup brings together the most comprehensive set of health and fitness features we've ever had.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: It's gratifying to receive almost daily reminders of the meaningful impact Apple's health innovations are having for users all over the world, changing, even saving lives.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: Meanwhile, we continue raising the bar across our AirPods lineup, whether it's the immersive listening experience of AirPods Pro 3 or the premium listening experience and exceptional active noise cancellation of AirPods Max 2.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: With live translation powered by Apple Intelligence, people are crossing language barriers and connecting like never before.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: As I mentioned earlier, we're excited about the work we're doing on the next generation of Apple Intelligence, including Siri AI and the AI features we're developing across our platforms.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: These experiences are intuitive and useful, while also deeply integrated in a way that's personal and private with the latest models running on-device and on servers using private cloud compute.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: We began laying the groundwork for users to have the best possible experience with AI when we introduced the Neural Engine in 2017.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: Ever since then, we've innovated and invested deliberately in silicon, systems, and scalable unified memory architecture designed with AI at their core.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: What sets Apple apart is the unique combination of massive unified memory bandwidth, industry-leading power-efficient performance, and deep on-device intelligence, all built around the customer experience from the ground up.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: The result is that Apple has created the world's best hardware to experience AI, whether using Apple Intelligence, including Siri AI, or third-party offerings.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: Turning to services, revenue was $30.7 billion, a June quarter revenue record and up 12% from a year ago, despite significant sequential foreign exchange headwinds.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: We also set an all-time revenue record in developed markets and a June quarter record in emerging markets.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: Apple TV continues to leave audiences spellbound with new releases like "Widow's Bay" and "Cape Fear," alongside returning favorites like "Silo" and "Sugar."

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: Next week, we're excited that "Ted Lasso" is back for its fourth season.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: It was wonderful to see Apple TV earn the industry's top honors, adding Tony Awards this year to its Emmy, Grammy, and Oscar wins.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: We're also looking forward to this year's Emmy Awards, where Apple has landed a record 89 nominations, leading all networks in both the major drama and comedy series categories, with three Outstanding Drama Series nominations and three Outstanding Comedy Series nominations.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: "Widow's Bay" also stands out as the year's most nominated new program, earning 19 Emmy nominations.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: In the six and a half years since launch, Apple TV has earned more than 850 wins and nearly 3,800 nominations.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: In time for the World Cup, we expanded Apple Sports to include more than 170 countries and regions worldwide and made it easier than ever for fans to follow every moment of the tournament, from the opening game to the final whistle.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: In retail, we were pleased to announce Apple Upgrade this week for customers in the U.S. Apple Upgrade is a new hardware leasing program launched in partnership with Klarna and makes it even easier for customers to get their hands on Apple's latest products with a plan that's right for them.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: That means innovating to protect user privacy with the next generation of Apple Intelligence, or helping parents keep kids safe, as I mentioned earlier.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: In honor of Global Accessibility Awareness Day, we unveiled new features to help users get more out of the products they use every day.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: New intelligent capabilities are coming to VoiceOver, Magnifier, Voice Control, and Accessibility Reader to make them more useful and intuitive.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: We're also using on-device speech recognition to generate subtitles for video content without captions.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: All of these features were born out of Apple's long-standing commitment to ensuring that the benefits of technology are shared with everyone.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: As we continue to develop new capabilities for users around the world, we're also doing our part to invest in innovation close to home.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: Last year, we made a $600 billion commitment to the U.S. over four years, and now, as we said before, we plan to reinvest the tariff refunds we've received into the U.S.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: We're pleased with the progress we've already made advancing the American supply chain.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: Earlier this month, Apple announced a new agreement with Broadcom to design and produce custom silicon components and cutting-edge wireless connectivity technologies.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: The new multi-year agreement with Broadcom, which is part of Apple's American Manufacturing Program, is expected to exceed $30 billion.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: This marks our largest-ever American manufacturing program commitment.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: We're excited for the upcoming opening of the Apple Advanced Manufacturing Center in Houston.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: The center is located in a facility where we currently assemble advanced AI servers.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: Later this year, we'll make Mac mini there, too.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: The center will teach students, supplier employees, and business of all sizes the same innovative processes we use to make our products.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: We have an exciting fall ahead and an incredible future beyond.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: Our roadmap is phenomenal, and we are so excited about the way Siri AI will enrich our users' lives.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: I couldn't be more excited to watch our phenomenal story of innovation continue to unfold, and I've never been more confident that the best is yet to come.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: Our revenue of $109.4 billion was up 16% year-over-year, a June quarter revenue record.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: We saw strong performance around the world, with double-digit growth in every geographic segment despite supply constraints.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: Products revenue was $78.7 billion, up 18% year-over-year, driven by double-digit growth on iPhone and Mac, both of which set new June quarter records.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: Our installed base of over two and a half billion active devices has reached another all-time high across all major product categories and geographic segments.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: Services revenue was $30.7 billion, up 12% year-over-year.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: We set revenue records in every services category, including all-time records in cloud services and payment services.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: Company gross margin was 50.1%, up 80 basis points sequentially.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: Products gross margin was 40.1%, up 140 basis points sequentially.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: Services gross margin was 75.6%, down 110 basis points sequentially, driven by a different mix.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: Operating expenses came in at $19.1 billion, up 23% year-over-year, driven by investments in R&D. Net income was $29.8 billion.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: Diluted earnings per share was $2.02, up 29% year-over-year, and included $0.11 of favorable impact from tariff refunds.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: Operating cash flow was very strong at $34.4 billion.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: iPhone revenue was $54.3 billion, up 22% year-over-year, driven by the iPhone 17 family.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: We grew double digits in the vast majority of markets we track and reached June quarter revenue records across both developed and emerging markets.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: The iPhone active install base grew to an all-time high and set a June quarter record for upgraders.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: We were thrilled with the response to the iPhone 17 family.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: Customer satisfaction in the U.S. was recently measured at 99% by 451 Research.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: Mac revenue was $10.4 billion, up 29% year-over-year, a new June quarter record, driven by the strength of MacBook Neo and MacBook Pro.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: We grew in both developed and emerging markets, with strong double-digit growth in markets like Latin America, India, and Southeast Asia.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: The customer reception to MacBook Neo has been incredible.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: As Tim mentioned, Mac had its best quarter ever for customers new to the Mac and for upgraders worldwide, including in the U.S., China Mainland, and India.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: In the U.S., customer satisfaction for Mac was recently measured at 95%.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: iPad revenue was $6.2 billion, down 6% year-over-year, driven by the continued difficult compare against the launch of the A16-powered iPad in the prior year.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: At the same time, the iPad install base reached a new all-time high, and over half of the customers who purchased an iPad were new to the product.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: 451 Research recently measured customer satisfaction at 98% in the U.S.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: Wearables, home, and accessories revenue was $7.9 billion, up 6% year-over-year, driven by strength in wearables and accessories, and we saw growth in both developed and emerging markets.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: The wearables install base reached a new all-time high.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: We set a June quarter record for upgraders on Apple Watch, and over half the customers purchasing an Apple Watch during the quarter were new to the product.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: In the U.S., customer satisfaction on Apple Watch was reported at 95%.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: Our services revenue reached a June quarter record of $30.7 billion, up 12% year-over-year, despite significant sequential FX headwinds.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: For the total services business, we saw double-digit growth in the vast majority of markets we track.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: We set records in every category, with June quarter records in advertising, App Store, AppleCare, Apple Music, and Apple TV+, as well as all-time records in cloud services and payment services.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: We are optimistic about the long-term future of our services business.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: With our large install base of over two and a half billion active devices, we have an incredibly strong foundation for growth opportunities.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: Our services continue to attract more customers, and we have now surpassed one and a half billion in paid subscriptions.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: Both transacting and paid accounts reached new all-time highs in the quarter, with double-digit growth for both in emerging markets.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: We continue to improve and expand our services offerings, from powerful updates to Creator Studio to exciting new features we're bringing to services later this year, like splitting bills with Apple Cash using visual intelligence.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: Organizations are using the Apple platform to drive AI innovation and empower the next generation of students.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: Starting with enterprise, Morgan Stanley has deployed over 20,000 iPhone 17 devices globally as part of a shift from employee-owned to corporate-owned devices for liability and security.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: More companies are choosing Mac for on-device AI advantages, including lower costs, better performance, and enhanced privacy and security.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: At Disney, creative teams are increasingly turning to Mac for on-device AI workflows that reduce overall cloud token costs and keep their IP secure.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: Crédit Agricole, France's leading retail bank, is using on-device AI on MacBook Pro to streamline regulatory workflows, reducing manual processing time by over 80%.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: Our newest addition to the Mac lineup, MacBook Neo, is reaching new enterprise users in many environments, from bank branches to retail storefronts.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: In education, MacBook Neo continued to accelerate adoption of Apple products, with many districts leveraging Apple Financial Services to deploy at scale.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: In fact, in the last quarter, about half of the MacBook Neo large purchases by U.S. education institutions displaced Windows and Chromebook devices.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: This included $4 billion in dividends and equivalents and $25.8 billion in share repurchases.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: Importantly, the color we're providing assumes that global tariff rates, policies, and their application remain in effect as of this call, and the global macroeconomic outlook does not worsen from today.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: We also expect our September quarter total company revenue to be impacted by two main factors.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: First, we expect foreign exchange to be a sequential headwind of about two and a half percentage points to the year-over-year total company growth rate from the June quarter to the September quarter.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: Second, we expect the impact from supply constraints to increase significantly sequentially.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: The projected supply constraints in the September quarter affect iPhone, Mac, and iPad.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: As a result, we expect our September quarter total company revenue to grow between 9%-11% year-over-year.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: On iPhone, we expect to continue to see high levels of demand.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: However, we do expect iPhone revenue to be impacted by these foreign exchange headwinds and supply constraints.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: Therefore, we expect the September quarter reported growth rate for iPhone to be mid-teens year-over-year.

signals.sentence: For services, we expect the September quarter year-over-year reported growth rate to be largely similar to what we reported in the June quarter after removing the negative sequential impact of about two and a half percentage points from foreign exchange that we just described.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: We expect gross margin to be between 47%-48%.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: This includes an expected benefit of approximately one percentage point related to tariff refunds.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: We expect OIE to be around $350 million, excluding any potential impact from the mark to market of minority investments, and our tax rate to be around 16.5%.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: Finally, today, our board of directors has declared a cash dividend of $0.27 per share of common stock payable on August 13th, 2026, to shareholders of record as of August 10th, 2026.

signals.sentence: As you know, this will be my final earnings call, and John will lead these calls going forward.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: The transition is going seamlessly, and I am beyond excited for John to step into his new role and lead Apple into its next era.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: As I've said, I couldn't be more confident in his leadership, in our executive team, and in the extraordinary people at Apple who are determined to enrich the lives of our users all over the world.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook

signals.sentence: The dynamics Tim mentioned, combined with the foreign exchange impact I mentioned earlier sequentially, is really what's built into the 9%-11% guidance we're giving for the September total company revenue year-over-year growth rate.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: Beyond September, we're not providing any color at this point.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: I think you mentioned December, so we're not providing any kind of color or guidance beyond the September quarter.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: It's an incredibly strong iPhone and Mac product cycle that has really yielded demand beyond our expectation.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: In Arizona, we do source over 100 million components this year out of Arizona, it is part of our $600 billion commitment to the U.S., and we could not be more pleased with how that fab has ramped and is producing for us.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: On the pricing front, we reluctantly raised prices, I would say.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: We did it because we're in what I would characterize as a 100-year flood on the memory pricing, with exponential increases in memory prices.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: One is we had the theatrical release of F1, which is one of the highest grossing sports films in history, and this year we didn't have a theatrical release.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: We did see some headwinds in mobile gaming.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: In the U.S., we do continue to operate under a court ruling impacting the link-out transactions.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: We're pleased the Supreme Court will hear our appeal.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: Despite this, the App Store did set a June quarter revenue record.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: There are several positive trends in the services business.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: During the June quarter, we saw strong double-digit growth in categories like cloud services, video, payment services, and advertising.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: We set revenue records in every category with June quarter records in advertising, the App Store, AppleCare, music, and video, where Apple TV+ viewership reached an all-time high in the quarter.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: We also set all-time records in cloud services and payment services, where Apple Pay saw a record level of users in both developed and emerging markets.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: Services also had a June quarter record in emerging markets.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: As we outlined in the prepared remarks, our services continue to attract more customers, and we now have surpassed one and a half billion in paid subscriptions.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: Our transacting and paid accounts hit an all-time high with double-digit growth in both those two in emerging markets.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: I think when I step back, if I look at how we landed versus our expectations that we had outlined in the March quarter for the June quarter, I would say that we roughly met our expectations, but we did see a bit more softness on mobile gaming in the App Store.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: As we go into the September quarter, what I would say is we expect foreign exchange will continue to be a headwind.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: We expect foreign exchange to drive about a 5 percentage point headwind to the year-over-year growth rate from the March to September quarter.

signals.speaker: Kevan Parekh
signals.sentence: If we look at the sequential change from the June quarter, the 12% services we reported to what we're guiding for the September quarter, we are going to see another two and a half point sequential headwind.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: It's not obvious, I would say.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: It's not obvious in the data that what you're asking is true.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: Obviously, we've now had to increase prices on iPad and Mac, the price elasticity there, it's just too early to come to a definitive conclusion of what happens there.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: I think there are enormous opportunities for Apple moving forward in AI.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: I'm so excited about Siri AI and where it is and where it's going.

signals.sentence: Of course, the ability to run some percentage of request on device is also very strategic and sort of a competitive weapon, if you will.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: I could not be more excited about the opportunities there.

signals.speaker: Tim Cook
signals.sentence: Generally speaking, as you know, we have been growing our OpEx and spending more in AI in general and quite a bit more.

signals.sentence: There are other locations on the P&L other than OpEx, like COGS etc., that also have AI expenditures.

signals.sentence: You look at the drivers of that, more than 100% of that can be explained by the memory cost change that Tim outlined.

signals.sentence: As Tim outlined earlier when we talked a bit about the dynamics around the memory costs, is we did see some partial offsets from things like the benefit of carry and inventory, reduction in non-memory component costs, and some favorable mix.
